+"""Abstract Gemmini RoCC instruction stream, and front ends for ACT asm.py and hand-written C.
+
+Both front ends lower to the same vocabulary -- the RoCC instructions the mesh actually
+executes -- so an ACT kernel and its hand-written C counterpart can be compared directly.
+
+Encodings follow ``gemmini-rocc-tests/include/gemmini.h``:
+
+  gemmini_extended_mvin (funct 2) / mvin2 (funct 1) / mvin3 (funct 14)
+      (dram_addr, spad_addr, cols, rows)
+  gemmini_extended_mvout (funct 3)
+      (dram_addr, spad_addr, cols, rows)
+  gemmini_extended_preload (funct 6)
+      (BD, C, BD_cols, BD_rows, C_cols, C_rows)
+  gemmini_extended_compute_preloaded (funct 4) / _accumulated (funct 5)
+      (A, BD, A_cols, A_rows, BD_cols, BD_rows)
+
+The short forms default every shape argument to DIM; the upstream kernels write the same
+operation both ways, e.g. matrix_ABC.c:125 ``gemmini_extended_mvout(OUT, OUT_sp_addr, DIM, DIM)``
+against matrix_ABC+A.c:113 ``gemmini_mvout(OUT, OUT_sp_addr)``.
+
+The accumulator is addressed by tagging the top bits of a scratchpad address: bit ADDR_LEN-1
+selects the accumulator, bit ADDR_LEN-2 additionally selects accumulate-on-write, and an
+all-ones address is the discard operand GARBAGE_ADDR.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import re
+from collections import Counter
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+DIM = 16
+ADDR_LEN = 32
+
+ACC_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 1)
+ACC_ACCUMULATE_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 2)
+# Reads the accumulator at its own s32 width; without it the readout narrows to elem_t.
+ACC_FULL_WIDTH_BIT = 1 << (ADDR_LEN - 3)
+GARBAGE_ADDR = (1 << ADDR_LEN) - 1
+
+
+# --- addresses ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Addr:
+    """A RoCC address operand: a dram buffer, a scratchpad row, or an accumulator row."""
+
+    space: str  # "dram" | "spad" | "acc" | "garbage"
+    index: object = None
+    accumulate: bool = False
+    full_width: bool = False
+
+    def __str__(self):
+        if self.space == "garbage":
+            return "garbage"
+        if self.space == "acc":
+            width = ":s32" if self.full_width else ""
+            return f"acc[{self.index}]{'+' if self.accumulate else ''}{width}"
+        return f"{self.space}[{self.index}]"
+
+
+def decode_local(value):
+    """Split a raw RoCC scratchpad operand into its spad / accumulator / garbage meaning."""
+    value &= (1 << ADDR_LEN) - 1
+    if value == GARBAGE_ADDR:
+        return Addr("garbage")
+    if value & ACC_BIT:
+        return Addr("acc", value & ~(ACC_BIT | ACC_ACCUMULATE_BIT | ACC_FULL_WIDTH_BIT),
+                    bool(value & ACC_ACCUMULATE_BIT), bool(value & ACC_FULL_WIDTH_BIT))
+    return Addr("spad", value)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Instr:
+    op: str
+    operands: tuple
+    shape: tuple
+
+    def key(self):
+        """Opcode plus shape -- what the mesh spends cycles on, independent of allocation."""
+        return (self.op, self.shape)
+
+    def __str__(self):
+        ops = ", ".join(str(o) for o in self.operands)
+        shape = ", ".join(str(s) for s in self.shape)
+        return f"{self.op}({ops}; {shape})"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Program:
+    """A straight-line RoCC stream plus the configuration prologue it runs under."""
+
+    name: str
+    instrs: list
+    config: list
+
+    def mix(self):
+        return Counter(i.key() for i in self.instrs)
+
+    def order(self):
+        return [i.key() for i in self.instrs]
+
+
+# --- ACT asm.py front end ----------------------------------------------------
+
+_API_CALL = re.compile(r"^\s*api\.(\w+)\((.*)\)\s*$")
+_KWARG = re.compile(r"(\w+)\s*=\s*(-?\d+)")
+_BUFFER_ADDR = re.compile(r"'addr'\s*:\s*(\d+)")
+_BUFFER_LIST = re.compile(r"(input|constant|output)\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\]\s*,?\s*\n", re.S)
+
+
+def _acc(addr, accumulate=False, full_width=False):
+    return Addr("acc", addr, accumulate, full_width)
+
+
+def _spad(addr):
+    return Addr("spad", addr)
+
+
+def _mv(op, dram, local, cols, rows):
+    return Instr(op, (dram, local), (cols, rows))
+
+
+def _matmul(c_dst, a_src, b_src, d_src, i, j, k):
+    """One ACT matmul/mac becomes the preload + compute pair the hardware executes."""
+    bd = d_src if d_src is not None else Addr("garbage")
+    return [
+        Instr("preload", (b_src, c_dst), (j, k, j, i)),
+        Instr("compute_preloaded", (a_src, bd), (k, i, j, i)),
+    ]
+
+
+def lower_asm(path):
+    """Read an ACT-generated asm.py and lower its api.* calls to a RoCC stream."""
+    text = open(path).read()
+
+    roles = {}
+    for kind, body in _BUFFER_LIST.findall(text):
+        for n, addr in enumerate(_BUFFER_ADDR.findall(body)):
+            roles.setdefault((kind, int(addr)), f"{kind}{n}")
+
+    def dram(addr, write=False):
+        kind = "output" if write else "input"
+        role = roles.get((kind, addr)) or roles.get(("constant", addr))
+        if role is None:
+            role = roles.get(("output", addr)) or roles.get(("input", addr))
+        return Addr("dram", role if role else f"hbm{addr}")
+
+    instrs = []
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        m = _API_CALL.match(line)
+        if not m:
+            continue
+        op, args = m.group(1), dict((k, int(v)) for k, v in _KWARG.findall(m.group(2)))
+        rows, cols = args.get("rows"), args.get("cols")
+        hbm, sp, acc = args.get("hbm_addr"), args.get("sp_addr"), args.get("acc_addr")
+
+        if op == "mvin_spad":
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvin", dram(hbm), _spad(sp), cols, rows))
+        elif op == "mvin_acc":
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvin", dram(hbm), _acc(acc, full_width=True), cols, rows))
+        elif op == "mvin_acc_low":
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvin2", dram(hbm), _acc(acc), cols, rows))
+        elif op == "mvin_acc_low_add":
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvin2", dram(hbm), _acc(acc, True), cols, rows))
+        elif op in ("mvout_spad", "mvout_spad_relu"):
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvout", dram(hbm, True), _spad(sp), cols, rows))
+        elif op in ("mvout_acc", "mvout_acc_relu"):
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvout", dram(hbm, True), _acc(acc, full_width=True), cols, rows))
+        elif op in ("mvout_acc_low", "mvout_acc_low_relu"):
+            instrs.append(_mv("mvout", dram(hbm, True), _acc(acc), cols, rows))
+        elif op in ("matmul8", "mac8", "matmul32", "mac32"):
+            to_acc = op.endswith("32")
+            dst = _acc(args["C_dst"]) if to_acc else _spad(args["C_dst"])
+            d = args.get("D_src")
+            if d is None:
+                d_addr = None
+            elif op == "mac32":
+                d_addr = _acc(d)
+            else:
+                d_addr = _spad(d)
+            instrs.extend(_matmul(dst, _spad(args["A_src"]), _spad(args["B_src"]), d_addr,
+                                  args["DIM_I"], args["DIM_J"], args["DIM_K"]))
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"{path}: no RoCC lowering for api.{op}")
+
+    return Program(path, instrs, config=[])
+
+
+# --- hand-written C front end ------------------------------------------------
+
+_CALL = re.compile(r"\b(gemmini_\w+)\s*\(")
+_DEFINE = re.compile(r"^\s*#\s*define\s+(\w+)\s+(.+?)\s*$", re.M)
+# Some kernels hold an address in a local instead of a #define, e.g. reduce_i32.c's
+# "uint32_t out_sp_addr = (1 << (ADDR_LEN-1)) | (1 << (ADDR_LEN-3));".
+_CONST_DECL = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:const\s+)?u?int\d*_t\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*([^;]+);", re.M)
+_CAST = re.compile(r"\(\s*(?:unsigned\s+|signed\s+)?\w+_t\s*\**\s*\)|\(\s*(?:unsigned|signed|int|char|void)\s*\**\s*\)")
+_SIZEOF = re.compile(r"sizeof\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)")
+_IDENT = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_]\w*$")
+
+_ENV = {
+    "DIM": DIM,
+    "ADDR_LEN": ADDR_LEN,
+    "GARBAGE_ADDR": GARBAGE_ADDR,
+    "MVIN_SCALE_IDENTITY": 1,
+    "ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY": 1,
+    "NO_ACTIVATION": 0,
+    "RELU": 1,
+    "OUTPUT_STATIONARY": 0,
+    "WEIGHT_STATIONARY": 1,
+    "OS": 0,
+    "WS": 1,
+    "false": 0,
+    "true": 1,
+}
+
+# Short forms default every shape argument to DIM; see the module docstring.
+_C_FORMS = {
+    "gemmini_mvin": ("mvin", "{0}, {1}, DIM, DIM"),
+    "gemmini_extended_mvin": ("mvin", None),
+    "gemmini_extended_mvin2": ("mvin2", None),
+    "gemmini_extended_mvin3": ("mvin3", None),
+    "gemmini_mvout": ("mvout", "{0}, {1}, DIM, DIM"),
+    "gemmini_extended_mvout": ("mvout", None),
+    "gemmini_preload": ("preload", "{0}, {1}, DIM, DIM, DIM, DIM"),
+    "gemmini_preload_zeros": ("preload", "GARBAGE_ADDR, {0}, DIM, DIM, DIM, DIM"),
+    "gemmini_extended_preload": ("preload", None),
+    "gemmini_compute_preloaded": ("compute_preloaded", "{0}, {1}, DIM, DIM, DIM, DIM"),
+    "gemmini_extended_compute_preloaded": ("compute_preloaded", None),
+    "gemmini_compute_accumulated": ("compute_accumulated", "{0}, {1}, DIM, DIM, DIM, DIM"),
+    "gemmini_extended_compute_accumulated": ("compute_accumulated", None),
+}
+
+
+def _split_args(text):
+    """Split a call's argument list on commas that are not nested in parentheses."""
+    args, depth, start = [], 0, 0
+    for n, ch in enumerate(text):
+        if ch in "([":
+            depth += 1
+        elif ch in ")]":
+            depth -= 1
+        elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
+            args.append(text[start:n])
+            start = n + 1
+    args.append(text[start:])
+    return [a.strip() for a in args]
+
+
+def _call_at(text, pos):
+    """Return (args, end) for the call whose opening paren is at pos."""
+    depth = 0
+    for n in range(pos, len(text)):
+        if text[n] == "(":
+            depth += 1
+        elif text[n] == ")":
+            depth -= 1
+            if depth == 0:
+                return _split_args(text[pos + 1:n]), n + 1
+    raise ValueError("unbalanced call")
+
+
+class _Evaluator:
+    """Evaluates the integer address expressions the upstream kernels write inline."""
+
+    def __init__(self, defines):
+        self.env = dict(_ENV)
+        for name, body in defines.items():
+            try:
+                self.env[name] = self.value(body)
+            except ValueError:
+                continue
+
+    def value(self, expr):
+        expr = _SIZEOF.sub("1", _CAST.sub("", expr)).replace("&", "").strip()
+        # Strip a redundant outer pair only when the leading "(" is closed by the
+        # trailing ")". Counting parens instead would mangle "((a)|(b))" into "a)|(b".
+        while expr.startswith("(") and expr.endswith(")"):
+            depth = 0
+            for n, ch in enumerate(expr):
+                depth += (ch == "(") - (ch == ")")
+                if depth == 0 and n != len(expr) - 1:
+                    break
+            else:
+                expr = expr[1:-1].strip()
+                continue
+            break
+        try:
+            node = ast.parse(expr, mode="eval")
+        except SyntaxError:
+            raise ValueError(expr)
+        return self._eval(node.body)
+
+    def _eval(self, node):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, int):
+            return node.value
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+            if node.id not in self.env:
+                raise ValueError(node.id)
+            return self.env[node.id]
+        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
+            return -self._eval(node.operand)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+            lhs, rhs = self._eval(node.left), self._eval(node.right)
+            for kind, fn in ((ast.Add, lambda a, b: a + b), (ast.Sub, lambda a, b: a - b),
+                             (ast.Mult, lambda a, b: a * b), (ast.LShift, lambda a, b: a << b),
+                             (ast.RShift, lambda a, b: a >> b), (ast.BitOr, lambda a, b: a | b)):
+                if isinstance(node.op, kind):
+                    return fn(lhs, rhs)
+        raise ValueError(ast.dump(node))
+
+
+def _dram_name(expr):
+    """The dram buffer an mvin/mvout argument names, stripped of casts, & and indexing."""
+    expr = _CAST.sub("", expr).strip().lstrip("&").strip()
+    expr = re.split(r"[\[\(]", expr, 1)[0].strip()
+    if not _IDENT.match(expr):
+        raise ValueError(f"cannot name dram buffer from {expr!r}")
+    return expr
+
+
+def _timed_region(text):
+    """The straight-line span between the read_cycles() calls that bracket the gemmini work."""
+    marks = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"\bread_cycles\s*\(", text)]
+    calls = [m.start() for m in _CALL.finditer(text)
+             if not re.match(r"gemmini_(config|extended\d*_config|flush|fence)",
+                             _CALL.match(text, m.start()).group(1))]
+    calls = [c for c in calls if _CALL.match(text, c).group(1) in _C_FORMS]
+    if not calls:
+        raise ValueError("no gemmini instruction calls found")
+    start = max([m for m in marks if m < calls[0]], default=0)
+    end = min([m for m in marks if m > calls[-1]], default=len(text))
+    if any(m for m in marks if calls[0] < m < calls[-1]):
+        raise ValueError("more than one timed region")
+    return text[start:end]
+
+
+def parse_c(path, dram_roles=None):
+    """Read a hand-written Gemmini kernel and lift its timed region to a RoCC stream."""
+    text = open(path).read()
+    names = dict(_DEFINE.findall(text))
+    names.update(_CONST_DECL.findall(text))
+    evaluator = _Evaluator(names)
+    region = _timed_region(text)
+    roles = dict(dram_roles or {})
+
+    def dram(expr):
+        name = _dram_name(expr)
+        if name not in roles:
+            # Matches the "constant<n>" role lower_asm() takes from the @kernel decorator.
+            roles[name] = f"constant{sum(1 for v in roles.values() if v.startswith('constant'))}"
+        return Addr("dram", roles[name])
+
+    instrs, config, pos = [], [], 0
+    while True:
+        m = _CALL.search(region, pos)
+        if not m:
+            break
+        name = m.group(1)
+        args, pos = _call_at(region, m.end() - 1)
+        if name not in _C_FORMS:
+            config.append(f"{name}({', '.join(args)})")
+            continue
+        op, template = _C_FORMS[name]
+        if template is not None:
+            args = _split_args(template.format(*args))
+        values = [evaluator.value(a) for a in args[1:]] if op.startswith("mv") else \
+                 [evaluator.value(a) for a in args]
+        if op.startswith("mvin") or op == "mvout":
+            local, cols, rows = values
+            instrs.append(_mv(op, dram(args[0]), decode_local(local), cols, rows))
+        else:
+            first, second = decode_local(values[0]), decode_local(values[1])
+            instrs.append(Instr(op, (first, second), tuple(values[2:])))
+
+    return Program(path, instrs, config)
+
+
+# --- value numbering ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def value_trace(program):
+    """Symbolically execute a RoCC stream, naming every value by how it was computed.
+
+    Returns (annotated instructions, {dram role: expression}). Addresses drop out, so a
+    kernel that reuses one scratchpad row compares equal to one that spreads across many.
+    """
+    slots, dram, pending = {}, {}, None
+    annotated, outputs = [], {}
+
+    def read(addr):
+        if addr.space == "dram":
+            return dram.setdefault(addr.index, addr.index)
+        if addr.space == "garbage":
+            return "garbage"
+        return slots.get((addr.space, addr.index), f"undef({addr})")
+
+    for instr in program.instrs:
+        # Operands are read before the write lands: a kernel that reuses one row for both
+        # an input and the result would otherwise record the result as its own operand.
+        if instr.op.startswith("mvin"):
+            src, dst = instr.operands
+            value = source = read(src)
+            if dst.accumulate:
+                value = f"add({read(Addr(dst.space, dst.index))}, {value})"
+            annotated.append((instr, (source,)))
+            slots[(dst.space, dst.index)] = value
+        elif instr.op == "mvout":
+            target, src = instr.operands
+            value = read(src)
+            dram[target.index] = value
+            outputs[target.index] = value
+            annotated.append((instr, (value,)))
+        elif instr.op == "preload":
+            bd, c = instr.operands
+            pending = (read(bd), c)
+            annotated.append((instr, (pending[0],)))
+        else:
+            a, bd = instr.operands
+            weight, dst = pending
+            left, bias = read(a), read(bd)
+            value = f"mm({left}, {weight})"
+            if bd.space != "garbage":
+                value = f"add({value}, {bias})"
+            if dst.accumulate:
+                value = f"add({read(Addr(dst.space, dst.index))}, {value})"
+            annotated.append((instr, (left, bias)))
+            slots[(dst.space, dst.index)] = value
+            pending = None
+
+    return annotated, outputs
+
+
+def flow_mix(annotated):
+    return Counter((i.op, i.shape, values) for i, values in annotated)

+
+JOBS=$(( $(nproc) > 2 ? $(nproc) - 2 : 1 ))

+        -j) JOBS=$2; shift 2 ;;
+        --rerun-exo-sweep) EXO_SWEEP=1; shift ;;
+        *) echo "Usage: $0 [-j N] [--rerun-exo-sweep]"; exit 1 ;;
+    esac
+done
+
+# Formats elapsed seconds as Xs / XmYYs / XhYYm.
+format_elapsed() {
+    local s=$1
+    if [ "$s" -ge 3600 ]; then printf '%dh %02dm' $((s / 3600)) $(((s % 3600) / 60))
+    elif [ "$s" -ge 60 ]; then printf '%dm %02ds' $((s / 60)) $((s % 60))
+    else printf '%ds' "$s"; fi
+}

+else
+    LOGDIR="$HARNESS/results"
+fi
+

+    exit 1
+fi
+
+mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
+
+# Cross-compiles tests/*.c; both streams go to log_name.

+    local log_name=$1 log t0 t1 built
+    log="$LOGDIR/$log_name"
+    t0=$(date +%s)
+    "$HERE/setup-tests.sh" > "$log" 2>&1
+    t1=$(date +%s)
+    # Each kernel builds baremetal, linux, and pk variants -- count only baremetal.
+    built=$(awk '/^Built binaries in/ { f = 1; next } f && /-baremetal$/ { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$log")
+    echo "        Built $built baremetal binaries | riscv64-unknown-elf, $JOBS jobs | $(format_elapsed $((t1 - t0)))"

+crosscompile "gemmini-crosscompile.log"
+

+echo "  (2.2.4) Running the SW-library kernels on Verilator..."

+
+echo
+echo "(2.3) Experiment: Exo loop-fission sweep -- RTL performance"

+echo "      Metric:  Verilator cycle counts vs the Exo library"
+echo "      Figure:  21(a), Appendix F"
+if [ "$EXO_SWEEP" = 1 ]; then
+    echo
+    echo "  (2.3.1) Generating the Exo loop-fission variants..."
+    python "$HERE/exo_sweep.py" generate
+
+    echo
+    echo "  (2.3.2) Cross-compiling the Exo variants for the Gemmini SoC..."
+    crosscompile "gemmini-exo-crosscompile.log"
+
+    echo
+    echo "  (2.3.3) Running the Exo loop-fission sweep on Verilator..."
+    "$HERE/exo-sweep.sh" -j "$JOBS"

+    echo "      Pass --rerun-exo-sweep to measure all 112 again (more than a day)."
+fi

+#!/bin/bash
+# Run every Exo loop-fission variant on Verilator; write exo.csv.
+# setup-tests.sh must have cross-compiled them first. These are full GEMMs, so
+# it takes hours.
+# Usage: exo-sweep.sh [-j N]
+set -euo pipefail
+
+source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/env.sh"
+
+HERE="$HARNESS/scripts"
+LOGS="$HARNESS/results/exo-logs"
+
+JOBS=8
+if [ "${1:-}" = "-j" ]; then JOBS=$2; shift 2; fi
+
+mapfile -t kernels < <(python "$HERE/exo_sweep.py" list)
+
+mkdir -p "$LOGS"
+cd "$GEMMINI"
+
+start_ts=$(date +%s)
+
+for k in "${kernels[@]}"; do
+    while [ "$(jobs -rp | wc -l)" -ge "$JOBS" ]; do wait -n; done
+    ( ./scripts/run-verilator.sh "$k" > "$LOGS/$k.log" 2>&1 || true ) &
+done
+wait
+
+# Exo variants build with CHECK_RESULT off -- no per-kernel gold check.
+# report() below cross-checks accumulator/scratchpad rows instead.
+kernel_status() {
+    local log="$LOGS/$1.log"
+    if [ ! -f "$log" ]; then echo ",MISSING"; return; fi
+    local cycles
+    cycles=$(grep -oP 'Cycles taken: \K[0-9]+' "$log" | tail -1)
+    if [ -z "$cycles" ]; then
+        if grep -q 'Binary not found' "$log"; then echo ",NOT_BUILT"; else echo ",NO_CYCLES"; fi
+    else
+        echo "$cycles,VALIDATED"
+    fi
+}
+
+# Completion-time item lines, one per variant, in dispatch order (deterministic).
+name_width=0
+for k in "${kernels[@]}"; do
+    [ "${#k}" -gt "$name_width" ] && name_width=${#k}
+done
+n=${#kernels[@]}
+counter_width=${#n}
+validated=0
+i=0
+for k in "${kernels[@]}"; do
+    i=$((i + 1))
+    IFS=',' read -r cycles verdict <<< "$(kernel_status "$k")"
+    [ "$verdict" = "VALIDATED" ] && validated=$((validated + 1))
+    if [ -n "$cycles" ]; then
+        printf "[%*d/%d] %-*s | Cycles: %4d | %s\n" \
+            "$counter_width" "$i" "$n" "$name_width" "$k" "$cycles" "$verdict"
+    else
+        printf "[%*d/%d] %-*s | %s\n" \
+            "$counter_width" "$i" "$n" "$name_width" "$k" "$verdict"
+    fi
+done
+
+echo
+python "$HERE/exo_sweep.py" report
+
+if [ -n "${ACT_RUN_TIMINGS:-}" ]; then
+    printf 'Gemmini\t%d\t%d\t%s/%s exo variants\n' "$start_ts" "$(date +%s)" "$validated" "$n" >> "$ACT_RUN_TIMINGS"
+fi

+"""Loop-fission factor sweep for the Exo GEMM kernels.
+
+Every kernel in templates/exo/ has its tiling set by five #defines: io/jo are
+the outer tiling, i/j the tile sizes moved through the scratchpad, ko the
+partial sums iterated in the accumulator. `generate` writes into tests/ one
+variant per factor combination that fits Gemmini's accumulator and scratchpad;
+`report` turns the Verilator logs those variants produce into one table per
+GEMM shape.
+
+Usage: exo_sweep.py generate | list | report
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import itertools
+import os
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HARNESS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+TEMPLATES = HARNESS / "templates" / "exo"
+TESTS = HARNESS / "tests"
+RESULTS = HARNESS / "results"
+EXO_RESULTS = RESULTS / "exo"
+LOGS = RESULTS / "exo-logs"
+
+GEMMINI = Path(os.environ.get("GEMMINI", "/gemmini/chipyard/generators/gemmini"))
+PARAMS = GEMMINI / "software/gemmini-rocc-tests/include/gemmini_params.h"
+
+# Exo's own factors (io, i, jo, j), off the trailing comments its loop headers
+# carry: `for (io ...) { // 4`. matmul512 splits i into 2 and a commented-out 8.
+# matmul4 has no such comments; its factors are the literals its defines were
+# first written with, `#define io_max (4 * 196)` and `#define i_max (196 / 196)`.
+EXO_FACTORS = {
+    "matmul512_exofunc": (2, 16, 2, 4),
+    "matmul27_exofunc": (7, 7, 2, 8),
+    "matmul4_exofunc": (4, 196, 1, 4),
+    "matmul6_exofunc": (98, 8, 1, 1),
+    "matmul14_exofunc": (4, 49, 1, 8),
+    "matmul16_exofunc": (14, 14, 1, 2),
+}
+
+FACTORS = ("io_max", "i_max", "jo_max", "j_max", "ko_max")
+ROWS = ("res_rows", "a_rows", "b_rows")
+
+
+def limits():
+    """Accumulator and scratchpad row counts of the elaborated mesh."""
+    src = PARAMS.read_text()
+    val = lambda name: int(re.search(rf"^#define {name} (\d+)$", src, re.M).group(1))
+    return val("ACC_ROWS"), val("BANK_NUM") * val("BANK_ROWS")
+
+
+def templates():
+    """The kernels to sweep, in the order EXO_FACTORS records their factors."""
+    names = [p.stem for p in TEMPLATES.glob("*.c")]
+    return sorted(names, key=list(EXO_FACTORS).index)
+
+
+class Template:
+    def __init__(self, name):
+        self.name = name
+        self.src = (TEMPLATES / f"{name}.c").read_text()
+        define = lambda k: int(re.search(
+            rf"^\s*#define\s+{k}\b\s+(\d+)\s*$", self.src, re.M).group(1))
+        self.rows = {k: re.search(rf"^\s*int\s+{k}\s*=\s*([^;]+);", self.src, re.M).group(1)
+                     for k in ROWS}
+        m, n, k = re.search(r"tiled_matmul_auto\((\d+), (\d+), (\d+),", self.src).groups()
+        self.shape = f"{m}x{n}x{k}"
+        self.ko = define("ko_max")
+        self.i_product = define("io_max") * define("i_max")
+        self.j_product = define("jo_max") * define("j_max")
+
+    def rows_used(self, i, j):
+        env = {"i_max": i, "j_max": j, "ko_max": self.ko}
+        used = {k: eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, env) for k, expr in self.rows.items()}
+        return used["res_rows"], used["a_rows"] + used["b_rows"]
+
+    def variants(self):
+        """Every (io, i, jo, j) whose accumulator and scratchpad use fits."""
+        acc_rows, sp_rows = limits()
+        pairs = lambda n: [(a, n // a) for a in range(1, n + 1) if n % a == 0]
+        out = []
+        for (i, io), (j, jo) in itertools.product(pairs(self.i_product),
+                                                  pairs(self.j_product)):
+            acc, sp = self.rows_used(i, j)
+            if acc <= acc_rows and sp <= sp_rows:
+                out.append((io, i, jo, j, acc, sp))
+        return out
+
+    def variant_src(self, io, i, jo, j):
+        # CHECK_RESULT off: its rand() fill costs two orders of magnitude more
+        # simulated cycles than the timed region, and the mesh's timing does not
+        # depend on the data.
+        src = self.src
+        for key, val in (("io_max", io), ("i_max", i), ("jo_max", jo), ("j_max", j),
+                         ("CHECK_RESULT", 0)):
+            src = re.sub(rf"^(\s*#define\s+{key}\b)\s+\d+\s*$", rf"\g<1> {val}",
+                         src, count=1, flags=re.M)
+        return src
+
+
+def variant_name(base, io, i, jo, j):
+    return f"{base}_io_{io}_i_{i}_jo_{jo}_j_{j}"
+
+
+def all_variants():
+    for name in templates():
+        t = Template(name)
+        for io, i, jo, j, acc, sp in t.variants():
+            yield t, variant_name(name, io, i, jo, j), (io, i, jo, j, acc, sp)
+
+
+def generate():
+    TESTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    for stale in TESTS.glob("matmul*_exofunc_io_*.c"):
+        stale.unlink()
+    count = 0
+    for t, name, (io, i, jo, j, _, _) in all_variants():
+        (TESTS / f"{name}.c").write_text(t.variant_src(io, i, jo, j))
+        count += 1
+    print(f"Wrote {count} variants to {TESTS}")
+
+
+def read_log(name):
+    """Cycle count and the accumulator/scratchpad rows the binary itself reports."""
+    path = LOGS / f"{name}.log"
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return None
+    text = path.read_text()
+    cycles = re.findall(r"Cycles taken: (\d+)", text)
+    reported = re.search(r"ACC: (\d+), SP: (\d+)", text)
+    return {
+        "cycles": int(cycles[-1]) if cycles else None,
+        "acc": int(reported.group(1)) if reported else None,
+        "sp": int(reported.group(2)) if reported else None,
+    }
+
+
+def report():
+    rows = []
+    for t, name, (io, i, jo, j, acc, sp) in all_variants():
+        log = read_log(name)
+        rows.append({
+            "shape": t.shape, "kernel": name, "io": io, "i": i, "jo": jo,
+            "j": j, "ko": t.ko, "acc": acc, "sp": sp,
+            "cycles": log["cycles"] if log else None,
+            "is_exo": (io, i, jo, j) == EXO_FACTORS[t.name],
+            "mismatch": bool(log and log["acc"] is not None
+                             and (log["acc"], log["sp"]) != (acc, sp)),
+        })
+
+    EXO_RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    fields = ["io", "i", "jo", "j", "ko", "acc", "sp", "cycles", "speedup",
+              "is_exo", "is_best", "kernel", "mismatch"]
+    for shape in dict.fromkeys(r["shape"] for r in rows):
+        table = sorted((r for r in rows if r["shape"] == shape),
+                       key=lambda r: (-r["sp"], r["cycles"] or 0))
+        measured = [r for r in table if r["cycles"]]
+        exo = next((r for r in table if r["is_exo"]), None)
+        best = min(measured, key=lambda r: r["cycles"]) if measured else None
+        for r in table:
+            r["speedup"] = (exo["cycles"] / r["cycles"]
+                            if exo and exo["cycles"] and r["cycles"] else None)
+            r["is_best"] = r is best
+
+        print(f"\n{shape}  ({table[0]['kernel'].split('_io_')[0]})")
+        print(f"{'io':>5} {'i':>5} {'jo':>4} {'j':>4} {'ko':>4} {'ACC':>6} {'SP':>7} "
+              f"{'Cycles':>10} {'Speedup':>8}  ")
+        for r in table:
+            mark = "".join(["*" if r["is_best"] else " ", "E" if r["is_exo"] else " "])
+            cycles = r["cycles"] if r["cycles"] else "-"
+            speedup = f"{r['speedup']:.2f}" if r["speedup"] else "-"
+            note = "" if r["cycles"] else "  NO RESULT"
+            if r["mismatch"]:
+                note += "  ROWS MISMATCH"
+            print(f"{r['io']:>5} {r['i']:>5} {r['jo']:>4} {r['j']:>4} {r['ko']:>4} "
+                  f"{r['acc']:>6} {r['sp']:>7} {cycles:>10} {speedup:>8} {mark}{note}")
+        if best and exo:
+            print(f"  best {best['kernel']}  vs exo {exo['kernel']}  "
+                  f"{exo['cycles'] / best['cycles']:.2f}x")
+
+        with open(EXO_RESULTS / f"{shape}.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
+            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields, extrasaction="ignore")
+            writer.writeheader()
+            writer.writerows(table)
+
+    print(f"\nWrote one table per shape in {EXO_RESULTS}  (* best, E Exo's own factors)")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["generate", "list", "report"])
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.command == "generate":
+        generate()
+    elif args.command == "list":
+        print("\n".join(name for _, name, _ in all_variants()))
+    else:
+        report()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+composite,A+B+C,A_plus_B_plus_C,A_plus_B_plus_C_library
+composite,A+B+C+D,A_plus_B_plus_C_plus_D,A_plus_B_plus_C_plus_D_library
+composite,AxB+AxC,AxB_plus_AxC,AxB_plus_AxC_library
+composite,AxB+C+D,AxB_plus_C_plus_D,AxB_plus_C_plus_D_library
+composite,AxBxC,AxBxC,AxBxC_library
+composite,AxBxC+A,AxBxC_plus_A,AxBxC_plus_A_library
+composite,AxBxC+D,AxBxC_plus_D,AxBxC_plus_D_library
+composite,AxBxCxA,AxBxCxA,AxBxCxA_library

+)
+

+

+if [ $# -gt 0 ]; then

+done

+# Cycle count and gold-check status for one kernel.
+kernel_status() {
+    local log="$LOGS/$1.log"
+    if [ ! -f "$log" ]; then echo ",MISSING"; return; fi
+    local cycles
+    cycles=$(grep -oP 'Cycles taken: \K[0-9]+' "$log" | tail -1)
+    if [ -z "$cycles" ]; then
+        if grep -q 'Binary not found' "$log"; then echo ",NOT_BUILT"; else echo ",NO_CYCLES"; fi
+    elif grep -q 'Success' "$log"; then
+        echo "$cycles,OK"
+    else
+        echo "$cycles,UNCHECKED"
+    fi
+}
+
+# A kernel is only trusted when it both printed a cycle count and passed its own
+# gold check; kernels built with CHECK_RESULT 0 print no "Success" line.
+measure() {
+    for k in "${kernels[@]}"; do
+        echo "$k,$(kernel_status "$k")"
+    done
+}
+
+echo "$SWLIB" | awk -F, -v OFS=, '
+    NR == FNR { cyc[$1] = $2; st[$1] = $3; next }
+    FNR == 1 { print "class,label,kernel,cycles,baseline,baseline_cycles,status" }
+    {
+        a = cyc[$3]; b = cyc[$4]
+        if (a == "" || b == "") print $1, $2, $3, a, $4, b, "INCOMPLETE"
+        else print $1, $2, $3, a, $4, b, st[$3] "/" st[$4]
+    }
+' <(measure) - > "$RESULTS/swlib.csv"
+
+# Completion-time item lines, one per kernel, in dispatch order (deterministic).
+name_width=0
+for k in "${kernels[@]}"; do
+    [ "${#k}" -gt "$name_width" ] && name_width=${#k}
+done
+n=${#kernels[@]}
+counter_width=${#n}
+validated=0
+i=0
+for k in "${kernels[@]}"; do
+    i=$((i + 1))
+    IFS=',' read -r cycles status <<< "$(kernel_status "$k")"
+    kind="ACT-Gemmini"
+    [[ "$k" == *_library ]] && kind="Library"
+    case "$status" in
+        OK) verdict="VALIDATED"; validated=$((validated + 1)) ;;
+        UNCHECKED) verdict="MISMATCH" ;;
+        *) verdict="$status" ;;
+    esac
+    if [ -n "$cycles" ]; then
+        printf "[%*d/%d] %-*s | %-11s | Cycles: %4d | %s\n" \
+            "$counter_width" "$i" "$n" "$name_width" "$k" "$kind" "$cycles" "$verdict"
+    else
+        printf "[%*d/%d] %-*s | %-11s | %s\n" \
+            "$counter_width" "$i" "$n" "$name_width" "$k" "$kind" "$verdict"
+    fi
+done
+
+echo
+awk -F, '
+    NR == 1 { next }
+    {
+        n++; cls[n] = $1; lbl[n] = $2; act[n] = $4; base[n] = $6
+        if ($4 != "" && $6 != "" && $4 + 0 > 0) {
+            spd[n] = $6 / $4
+            log_sum += log(spd[n]); log_n++
+        }
+    }
+    END {
+        w1 = length("Class"); w2 = length("Kernel"); w3 = length("ACT-Gemmini")
+        w4 = length("Library"); w5 = length("Speedup")
+        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
+            if (length(cls[i]) > w1) w1 = length(cls[i])
+            if (length(lbl[i]) > w2) w2 = length(lbl[i])
+            if (length(act[i]) > w3) w3 = length(act[i])
+            if (length(base[i]) > w4) w4 = length(base[i])
+            sp[i] = (i in spd) ? sprintf("%.2fx", spd[i]) : ""
+            if (length(sp[i]) > w5) w5 = length(sp[i])
+        }
+        geomean = (log_n > 0) ? sprintf("%.2fx", exp(log_sum / log_n)) : ""
+        if (length(geomean) > w5) w5 = length(geomean)
+
+        fmt = "%-" w1 "s  %-" w2 "s  %" w3 "s  %" w4 "s  %" w5 "s\n"
+        printf fmt, "Class", "Kernel", "ACT-Gemmini", "Library", "Speedup"
+        printf "%s  %s  %s  %s  %s\n", bar(w1), bar(w2), bar(w3), bar(w4), bar(w5)
+        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf fmt, cls[i], lbl[i], act[i], base[i], sp[i]
+        printf "%s  %s  %s  %s  %s\n", bar(w1), bar(w2), bar(w3), bar(w4), bar(w5)
+        printf "%-" w1 "s  %-" w2 "s  %" w3 "s  %" w4 "s  %" w5 "s\n", "", "geomean", "", "", geomean
+    }
+    function bar(w,    s, i) { s = ""; for (i = 0; i < w; i++) s = s "-"; return s }
+' "$RESULTS/swlib.csv"
+
+echo
+echo "Cycle counts saved to evaluation/gemmini/results/swlib.csv."
+
+if [ -n "${ACT_RUN_TIMINGS:-}" ]; then
+    printf 'Gemmini\t%d\t%d\t%s/%s simulated\n' "$start_ts" "$(date +%s)" "$validated" "$n" >> "$ACT_RUN_TIMINGS"
+fi

+ls "$GEMMINI/software/gemmini-rocc-tests/build/local"
